Role Title: HR Director – Sanitaryware Factory Project

Business Context:
A new sanitaryware factory project is being established, with the workforce expected to grow from 100 employees in the first phase to 400 employees over five years. The HR Director will play a foundational role, joining from the establishment stage and shaping the HR function as the business scales.

Role Purpose:
To lead and develop the HR function from the ground up, ensuring effective personnel management, recruitment, policy development, and compliance with relevant laws and regulations throughout all phases of the factory’s growth.

Key Responsibilities:

1. HR Function Establishment and Development
- Design and implement the HR department’s structure, processes, and systems from the project’s inception.
- Develop and document HR policies and procedures tailored to the factory’s needs and in compliance with Saudi labor laws.
- Review and update policies as the organization grows and evolves.

2. Personnel Affairs Management
- Oversee all personnel affairs, including employee records, attendance, leave management, and contract administration.
- Ensure accurate and timely handling of employee documentation and compliance with legal requirements.

3. Recruitment and Onboarding
- Manage all stages of recruitment for the initial workforce (up to 100 employees in the first phase), scaling up to 400 employees over five years.
- Develop and execute recruitment plans, job postings, candidate screening, interviewing, and onboarding processes.

4. Compliance and Legal Awareness
- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant Saudi labor laws and regulations.
- Ensure all HR practices and policies are compliant and adapt to regulatory changes as needed.

5. Strategic HR Leadership
- Provide strategic input to support the factory’s growth, including workforce planning and organizational development.
- Advise management on HR best practices and contribute to the long-term development of the HR function.

Confirmed Requirements:
- Saudi nationality (pending legal review)
- Minimum 10 years of HR experience
- Ability to join from the establishment stage and manage HR through all phases of growth
- Experience in personnel affairs, recruitment, policy development, and legal compliance
- Strategic perspective on HR development

Work Arrangements:
- Official work location: Jeddah – MODON 3
- Initial work location: Madinah for 6 months to a maximum of 1 year, until the factory’s administrative building is ready

Important Details Awaiting Confirmation:
- Reporting line during establishment and after full operation
- Existing HR or administrative support resources
- Whether 10 years’ experience must include director-level or leadership roles
- Main priorities and expected outcomes for the first year
- Compensation, contract type, and benefits
- Any additional qualifications, certifications, or language requirements
